classifications.rationale: The President supplies an authority recital and section headings, but this segment directs no actor and itself creates no governance or legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: it is ordered as follows: PART I. ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY COUNCIL SECTION 101. Establishment of the Council.

classifications.rationale: The President immediately establishes and organizes an internal executive council, specifying its membership, meeting leadership, alternates, invitees, and observers; these are executive-branch organizational arrangements rather than changes to substantive legal rights.
classifications.evidence: There is hereby established the Environmental Quality Council

classifications.rationale: The segment assigns the Science Adviser an internal council office and a duty to assist the President, effective under the order without imposing a substantive legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: The Science Adviser to the President shall be the Executive Secretary of the Council

classifications.rationale: The Council must advise, review, recommend, encourage, assess, and coordinate environmental policy matters; these are internal planning and coordination functions, not dictated legal outcomes.
classifications.evidence: Facilitate coordination among departments and agencies of the Federal Government

classifications.rationale: The Council and Secretary are authorized or directed to review, study, advise, report, coordinate, and make resources available; any later program consequences remain discretionary and are not specified here.
classifications.evidence: The Council may conduct studies and make recommendations to the President

classifications.rationale: Executive offices and member agencies must provide administrative support, information, and assistance to the Council as available, which is internal operational support rather than a substantive legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: shall provide or arrange for necessary administrative and staff services, support, and facilities for the Council

classifications.rationale: Although much of the segment organizes and preserves an advisory committee, it also itself gives committee members a present statutory travel-and-expense entitlement; that substantive consequence occurs by operation of this segment rather than through a later agency decision.
classifications.evidence: shall be entitled to receive travel and expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence

classifications.rationale: The President immediately terminates prior advisory bodies and revokes earlier executive orders, but these are internal executive organizational changes expressly treated as Code 1 housekeeping.
classifications.evidence: are hereby terminated and the following are revoked
